name: kubai-icons
title: kubai-icons
description: Generates new icons in one fixed, consistent house style: a rulebook-driven design engine with a headless visual self-check and a static SVG exporter, companion to the Kubai icon library (2,600+ icons for React, Vue and plain SVG).
why: Icon generation in a single consistent style is a job no other design entry does — ui-ux-pro-max's data covers icon selection, not creation. Listed link-only: the skill's own license is source-available, bars translation and modified redistribution, and its text is Chinese, so it cannot be vendored into this English collection.
